page.notes: Woodcut emblem between the lines "universum Monarchiæ." and "FRANCOFVRTI;": two cherubs, a tree, a key or sword-like object, and a ribbon motto. The motto ribbon reads roughly "ONERATA RENIDET"; the second word is partly obscured, so it is marked [?]. The motto is transcribed above as a line. Not transcribed: the number "129030" at top right (digitiser or library number, not printed by the publisher); the oval library stamp "BIBLIOTHEQUE DE LA VILLE DE LYON" at lower left; the "Google" mark at lower right; scan dust and speckles. The word "Gallia" appears without the æ ligature in the scan and is copied as seen. No page number, running head, catchword or signature is printed.
